_schema: Room content. The renderer's trust boundary, enforced in room.js:
_plain: PLAIN TEXT, escaped on render: cards[].name, groups[].title, groups[].symbols[].n
_raw: RAW AUTHORED HTML, injected as-is: cards[].body, cards[].note, examples[].q, examples[].steps[], examples[].ans, groups[].symbols[].g
_rule: Anything moved between those two lists changes what the browser does with it. Plain fields must never contain markup; raw fields are trusted and must never hold anything a reader typed.

cards.name: Cell theory
cards.body: All living things are made of cells; cells arise from cells; the cell is life's basic unit.

cards.name: Prokaryotes vs eukaryotes
cards.body: Prokaryote: no nucleus or membrane-bound organelles (bacteria, archaea). Eukaryote: nucleus + organelles.

cards.name: Organelles
cards.body: Nucleus (DNA) · mitochondria (ATP) · ER (synthesis) · Golgi (sorting) · ribosomes (translation) · lysosomes (degradation) · chloroplast (photosynthesis).

cards.name: Membrane structure
cards.body: Phospholipid bilayer + embedded proteins (fluid mosaic); selectively permeable.

cards.name: Passive vs active transport
cards.body: Passive: down the gradient, no ATP (diffusion, osmosis, facilitated). Active: against the gradient, uses ATP (pumps).

cards.name: DNA structure
cards.body: Antiparallel double helix; A–T (2 H-bonds), G–C (3); sugar-phosphate backbone.

cards.name: Central dogma
cards.body: DNA → (transcription) → RNA → (translation) → protein.

cards.name: Genotype vs phenotype
cards.body: Genotype = the alleles carried. Phenotype = the observable trait (genotype + environment).

cards.name: Mutations
cards.body: Changes in DNA — point (silent, missense, nonsense), insertions/deletions (frameshift). The source of variation.

cards.name: Mendelian genetics
cards.body: Dominant/recessive alleles; segregation; independent assortment. Predict with Punnett squares.

cards.name: Gene regulation
cards.body: Promoters, enhancers, transcription factors; operons (prokaryotes); epigenetics.

cards.name: Cell cycle
cards.body: G1 → S (DNA replication) → G2 → M (mitosis), gated by checkpoints.

cards.name: Apoptosis
cards.body: Programmed (controlled) cell death via caspases — vs necrosis (uncontrolled).

cards.name: Cancer basics
cards.body: Loss of cell-cycle control: oncogenes (gain-of-function) + tumor-suppressor loss (e.g. p53).

cards.name: Immune system overview
cards.body: Barriers → innate → adaptive; key cells: B cells, T cells, macrophages.

cards.name: Innate vs adaptive
cards.body: Innate: fast, nonspecific. Adaptive: slower, specific, with memory (B & T cells).

cards.name: Antibodies
cards.body: Y-shaped proteins; the variable region binds a specific antigen epitope. Made by B/plasma cells.

cards.name: Vaccines
cards.body: Train adaptive immunity with a safe antigen → memory cells → fast response on real exposure.

cards.name: Homeostasis
cards.body: Maintaining stable internal conditions, usually by negative feedback.

cards.name: Natural selection
cards.body: Variation + heritability + differential survival/reproduction → adaptation over generations.

cards.name: Bioinformatics / BLAST
cards.body: Align sequences to find homology; BLAST searches databases for similar sequences; build phylogenetic trees.

examples.q: Identify the organelle from its job

steps: Glucose via a carrier, down its gradient → facilitated (passive)
Na⁺/K⁺ pump, against the gradient, uses ATP → active
Gametes: A, a from each parent
Variable region (paratope) binds a specific epitope
Safe antigen primes B & T cells

examples.ans: active transport runs on ATP — see Biochemistry
